title: Flat Amount for Major Appliances on a Missed Delivery Appointment
content:
For the missed-appointment credit of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery order under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a flat amount is given for the major appliances on the order, counted in units:

- two or more major appliance units: five dollars (5.00) for each unit;
- exactly one major appliance unit: a flat seven dollars fifty (7.50);
- no major appliance: nothing.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical orders).**

| Major appliance units on the order | Flat amount |
|---|---|
| 4 | 20.00, being 5.00 multiplied by 4 |
| 2 | 10.00 |
| 1 | 7.50 |
| 0 | nothing |
